2608.27790.title: Credo: Reusable Declarative Primitives for Agentic Workflows
2608.27790.paper_summary: An LLM application depends on both a model and a harness: the program that determines what each call sees, how many calls to make, and which answers to trust. Coding agents can now discover strong harnesses by searching over candidate programs, but the resulting artifact is an opaque block of imperative code whose logical steps, runtime signals, physical execution decisions, and prompt strategies remain implicit and task-specific, forcing subsequent tasks to start the harness search process from scratch. The potential for reuse, however, is substantial. A searched harness encodes significant knowledge, such as the logical steps that work, the signals that matter, the physical operator decisions that adapt execution, and the prompt strategies that are effective, yet this knowledge is buried in imperative code with no inspectable or reusable structure, nor does it carry any provenance or metadata. Credo addresses this problem by recovering a structured declarative description of a searched harness, tagging each extracted primitive with relevant metadata, and cataloguing all of it with provenance. A compiler can then bind stored primitives to generate harnesses for new tasks without having to start the search over from scratch. This paper provides preliminary results demonstrating the potential of our approach and lays out a related research agenda that the database community is well-positioned to tackle, including cost-based compilation over declarative catalogs and catalog maintenance under model and workload drift.
2608.27790.paper_summary_zh: 一個 LLM 應用依賴於模型和工具：該程序決定每個調用所看到的內容、要進行多少次調用以及信任哪些答案。編碼代理現在可以通過搜索候選程序來發現強大的工具，但產生的工件是一個不透明的命令式代碼塊，其邏輯步驟、運行時信號、物理執行決策和提示策略仍然隱含且特定於任務，迫使後續任務從頭開始進行工具搜索過程。然而，重用的潛力是巨大的。搜索過的工具編碼了重要的知識，例如有效的邏輯步驟、重要的信號、調整執行的物理操作決策以及有效的提示策略，但這些知識埋藏在沒有可檢查或可重用結構的命令式代碼中，也不攜帶任何來源或元數據。Credo 通過恢復搜索工具的結構化聲明描述來解決這個問題，為每個提取的原語標記相關的元數據，並將所有這些內容編目並附上來源。然後，編譯器可以將存儲的原語綁定以生成新任務的工具，而無需從頭開始進行搜索。本文提供了初步結果，展示了我們方法的潛力，並提出了一個相關的研究議程，數據庫社區在這方面具有良好的解決能力，包括基於成本的編譯、聲明型目錄的維護以及模型和工作負載漂移下的目錄維護。
